positions.title: Research Assistant

- Working with Professor Brian Davison to build a search engine that will allow for easier and efficient locating of datasets using HTML and CSS

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
- Introduced young students to Computer Science to invoke an early interest in the subject
- Traveled to various counties in Connecticut to offer Computer Science education, such as Java and Python to people of all backgrounds
- Created lesson plans for each session of the class tailored to the progress of the students
- Brought new employees to different sessions so that they could develop their teaching style
- Allowed students to create projects to show parents so they could view their children's' progress

positions.title: New Employee Trainer & Instructor
positions.description:
- Tutored hundreds of students in math and reading skills ranging from Kindergarten to 12th grades
- Provided academic guidance to students to improve their learning engagement and confidence
- Recorded data about students to adjust their learning track to help them get ahead of their class or help them catch up
- Trained new employees in the various necessary tasks to run the center
- Created advertisements and signs to invoke public interest for the summer camp program
- Communicated with parents to address their concerns and share their children's' progress

positions.title: Parks & Recreation Intern
positions.description:
- Maintained high standards of customer service during high-volume, fast-paced operations for 6 hours a shift
- Executed currency and credit transactions quickly and accurately to ensure customer satisfaction
- Interacted with the citizens of Darien to assist them with various issues
- Sold permits using the local government's software
- Assisted in organizing a festival for the public
